name: Digital Payment Settlement 3
definition: Specifies the information related to the digital payment settlement.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Financial instrument representing a sum of rights of the investor vis-a-vis the issuer.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Choice between different quantities related to the payment in digital asset.

DigitalLedgerIdentification.name: Digital Ledger Identification
DigitalLedgerIdentification.definition: Place of settlement expressed with a Digital Ledger Identifier. It identifies a digital ledger or distributed ledger system (for example, blockchain or similar platforms).
